recording.credit: PO and Stucco TINA HolmesJamie's notes: - The mix in Shakedown Street was a live work in progress for the first 6 minutes. The levels here were adjusted for a more even listening experience. - Shnid 96394 provided patch material for a small blip in Rooster, a few seconds of crowd before China Cat, about 4 minutes of drums, a 10 second spot in space and a tiny dropout in The Other One Jason's notes: - 96394 and 88940 adjusted for the following additional patch points: s1t01: 0:00:00 - 0:01:51 - 88940 s1t02: 0:00:00 - 0:00:08 - 96394 s1t02: 0:00:08 - 0:00:20 - 88940 s1t02: 0:13:40 - 0:14:22 - 88940 s1t03: 0:00:00 - 0:00:04 - 88940 s1t03: 0:08:50 - 0:08:56 - 88940 s1t04: all - 88940 s1t05: 0:00:00 - 0:00:13 - 96394 s1t05: 0:08:14 - 0:08:27 - 88940 s1t06: all - 88940 s1t07: 0:00:00 - 0:00:02 - 88940 s1t12: 0:04:38 - 0:04:46 - 88940 s2t01: 0:00:00 - 0:00:26 - 88940 s2t10: 0:04:15 - 0:05:11 - 88940 s2t11: 0:00:00 - 0:00:10 - 88940 s2t11: 0:06:26 - 0:06:33 - 88940
